theta_adjustment_review.decision: USE_1_8_ALTERNATIVE; nontrivial finite-risk contrast is valid
theta_adjustment_review.reason: For the two-step start-to-absorbing-goal experiment, p=1/4 gives actual goal failure 9/16 below 7/10, while p=1/8 gives 49/64 above 7/10. Both p values remain strictly between zero and one and therefore preserve the same structural relation and physical safe set. A prior structural contract covering both parameters no longer supplies the claimed risk cap by itself.
required_constraints: Bind the 9/16 and 49/64 claims to the actual source causalLaw and the same goal event/program in the completed WIT; these arithmetic values are not a substitute for that semantic equality.

For p=1/8, Good implies selectedAccepts=false: acceptance would contradict actual goal risk 49/64 > beta. The identity candidate can still receive noisyDecision=certified; it is the risk-budget check that withholds the deployment certificate. Do not claim every random record must withhold acceptance: bad calibration records retain the stated failure budget.

For p=1/4, Good alone does not guarantee acceptance. At N=4096, an empirical goal frequency 820/4096 differs from 1/4 by 51/1024 < 1/20 but yields budget 3878093/5242880 > 7/10; a sound oracle may abstain on this Good record.

The N=4 quarter-count fixture is an arithmetic regression and has capped confidence bound 1 at u=1/20. A nontrivial sampling witness must bind its actual larger-N record and confidence calculation separately (N=4096 gives raw B=48 exp(-512/25)). RNG seed reproducibility is not a proof of distributional source matching.
